papers.title: D$^2$ACCI: A Dual-Loop Diagnostic Protocol for Evidence-Preserving Agent Memory
papers.summary: Memory is a key capability of LLM agents. Persistent memory extends this across sessions---enabling recall, revision, and personalization. Yet its multi-stage pipeline (ingestion, retrieval, filtering, generation) makes failures difficult to localize: end-to-end evaluation reveals that an error occurred, but not which stage caused it. Existing evaluations often report aggregate performance without paired statistical comparisons, slice-level non-regression checks, or stage-level diagnostic traces. We propose D$^2$ACCI (Diagnostic-Driven Artifact-based Closed-loop Controlled Iteration), a dual-loop protocol whose outer diagnostic gate promotes, feature-flags, or rejects memory interventions based on paired evidence, protected-slice monitoring, and trace-level localizability. We further introduce DCR, a graded observability metric that measures whether failures remain localizable, and D$^2$ACCI-Eval, a reusable artifact for gate replay. We instantiate the protocol in MemStack and evaluate on three public benchmarks, achieving 93.59% on LoCoMo, 90.93% on LongMemEval, and 57.20% on PersonaMem-V2. Five paired ablations show that supplement extraction, session-memory retrieval, and Forget Guard yield statistically significant gains (+1.9 to +3.7pp, all p $\le$ .003). In contrast, BM25/RRF is retained as a monitored feature flag---a distinction invisible to aggregate-only evaluation. A diagnostic audit shows enriched traces substantially improve root-cause agreement over result-only relabeling. Diagnostic artifacts reach 98--100% DCR@3 versus 0% for results-only logs. These results establish that robust memory-system iteration demands traceable, statistically grounded, and regression-aware evidence---exactly the gap D$^2$ACCI fills.
papers.figure_caption: Figure 1: (a) Current end-to-end evaluation reports only aggregate accuracy; internal pipeline states are hidden and failures cannot be attributed to a specific stage. (b) D 2 ACCI emits per-stage traces, enabling paired gates to localize failures and drive targeted repairs.
papers.coarse_rationale: 该论文聚焦智能体记忆系统的诊断评估，提出双循环协议和观测性度量，统计严格，具有实用价值。
papers.newspaper_title: 把智能体记忆变成可追责的实验对象
papers.dek: D²ACCI 的重点不在提出更复杂的记忆模块，而在于把记忆干预置于可回放、可定位、可回归检查的证据门控流程中。它提示：端到端分数上升，并不等于系统知道自己为何变好或变坏。
papers.background_and_pain: 持久化记忆包含摄取、检索、过滤和生成等多个阶段。仅看最终任务表现，只能确认结果是否出错，不能判断错误来自哪一环；摘要进一步指出，既有评估常缺少配对统计比较、切片级非回归检查和阶段级诊断轨迹。对需要跨会话工作的智能体而言，这会使记忆改动难以审计，也容易掩盖局部能力退化。
core_innovations: 提出 D²ACCI 双循环诊断协议：外层诊断门依据配对证据、受保护切片和轨迹可定位性，对记忆干预执行晋级、特性开关保留或拒绝。
提出 DCR 可观测性指标与 D²ACCI-Eval 工件，用于衡量失败是否仍可被定位，并支持重放诊断门决策；在 MemStack 中实例化该协议。
papers.experimental_findings: 在三个公开基准上，摘要报告 LoCoMo 为 93.59%、LongMemEval 为 90.93%、PersonaMem-V2 为 57.20%。五组配对消融中，补充提取、会话记忆检索和 Forget Guard 带来 +1.9 至 +3.7 个百分点的统计显著增益，均满足 p ≤ 0.003；BM25/RRF 被保留为受监控的特性开关，而不是直接上线。诊断审计中，带增强轨迹的工件达到 98% 至 100% 的 DCR@3，结果日志为 0%。但摘要没有给出各基准的样本构成、完整比较设置、置信区间或跨任务迁移证据，因此这些数字不能外推为所有记忆架构的普遍保证。
papers.figure_explanation: 图中上半部分表示传统端到端评估：信息依次经过摄取、检索、过滤和生成，最终只得到总体分数，内部状态被隐藏，因而难以定位具体失败阶段。下半部分表示 D²ACCI 在各阶段加入诊断记录，输出如源数据标识、检索结果、过滤日志和答案等阶段性轨迹，并将这些证据交给配对门控，以支持接受、保留为特征开关或拒绝干预；其声称的贡献是提高故障定位能力并据此驱动针对性修复。

papers.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for improving reasoning in language and vision-language models, yet its strongest successes still depend heavily on ground-truth supervision (e.g., verifiable reward). Such annotations are costly to obtain and become increasingly scarce as reasoning capabilities advance beyond what humans can reliably evaluate. Self-rewarding RL reduces this dependence by enabling models to derive reward signals from their own completions. However, training solely on self-generated feedback can reinforce existing biases and suboptimal behaviors, reduce response diversity, and ultimately lead to homogenized responses and training collapse. In this work, we show that unsupervised reasoning can emerge through cooperative multi-agent training. We introduce Co-RL, a framework in which multiple decoupled models, sharing no parameters, are simultaneously optimized through RL using rewards derived from their peers. We further show that increasing cohort diversity, through heterogeneous model families, sizes, and rephrased training samples, reduces the correlated errors that drive self-reinforcing feedback loops. This diversity consistently improves reasoning performance, maintains behavioral diversity, and mitigates training collapse. Across text-only and multimodal domains, Co-RL consistently outperforms the base models and prior label-free approaches, while matching or surpassing supervised methods, without access to any ground-truth labels. Concretely, Co-RL yields average gains of 3.0-8.6% across seven text-only benchmarks for LLMs and 2.3-7.2% across four multimodal benchmarks for VLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/DrStranded/Co-RL.
papers.coarse_rationale: 本文提出Co-RL多智能体强化学习框架，通过同伴奖励实现无监督推理能力涌现，提升推理性能并缓解训练崩溃。
papers.newspaper_title: 无标签推理的薄弱环节，是同源错误的自我强化
papers.dek: Co-RL 将无监督推理训练从单模型自评改为多模型同伴奖励，并把模型与数据多样性作为抑制反馈回路的关键变量。其主要价值在于揭示：去掉人工标签后，奖励来源本身可能成为塌缩和偏差复制的瓶颈。
papers.background_and_pain: 推理强化学习的强结果通常依赖可验证奖励，但随着任务难度提升，人工可靠评估会变得稀缺。自奖励方法虽然降低标签依赖，却可能让模型重复自身偏差和次优行为，降低回答多样性，并形成同质化与训练塌缩。这里的“推理能力”应与显式 Chain-of-Thought 轨迹区分：摘要报告的是任务表现和行为多样性变化，并未声称验证了某种内部思维链机制。
core_innovations: 构造 Co-RL 多智能体强化学习框架：多个解耦且不共享参数的模型同时训练，奖励来自同伴完成结果，而非真实标签。
通过异构模型家族、模型规模和改写训练样本提高 cohort 多样性，以降低相关错误，缓解自我强化反馈回路。
papers.experimental_findings: 摘要称，Co-RL 在七个文本基准上为 LLM 带来平均 3.0% 至 8.6% 的增益，在四个多模态基准上为 VLM 带来 2.3% 至 7.2% 的增益；在文本和多模态领域均超过基础模型及既有无标签方法，并达到或超过监督方法。失效边界同样明确：摘要只说明多样性能够降低相关错误，未报告所需训练成本、不同 cohort 规模的收益曲线、各基准的方差或失败样本。因此不能据此判断多样性在低资源、强分布外或更长交互任务中仍然有效，也不能把“超过监督方法”理解为普遍替代监督信号。

papers.title: Collective Counterfactual Planning: Coordination, Consent, and Verification under Representational Constraints
papers.summary: Groups routinely complete projects that no single member can plan, execute, or verify alone. We propose a formal model of this phenomenon, Collective Counterfactual Planning (CCP), in which the binding limitation on each agent is neither capability, knowledge, nor observability, but representational geometry: each agent perceives the state, conceives moves, consents to actions, and certifies goal requirements only through a projection onto an agent-specific subspace of a common task space. Four gates jointly determine whether a team can reach a conjunctive goal and legitimately recognize that it has done so: the exogenous implementation coalitions required to perform each action, together with three representational gates -- conception, consent, and task-relative verification qualification. We define the Collective Counterfactual Solvability (CCS) problem, separating geometric feasibility, executable attainment, and validated completion. The results expose a positive-negative duality. Iterated cross-agent relay can unlock a solution that no one-shot pooling of individual plans contains, but any goal requirement depending essentially on the subspace dark to the entire team is unverifiable and therefore not validly completable, even when the trajectory accidentally attains it. Memoryless and audited consent further constrain different objects -- action directions versus cumulative trajectory states -- and neither dominates the other. A four-step exhaustive horizon-bounded solvability scheme is sound and complete under exact representation of the relay closure; restricted implementations remain sound on returned plans but need not be complete. The model gives one geometry for sequential mutual enabling, competent execution of steps whose purpose is invisible to the executor, forced sub-teaming at expertise boundaries, and completion that cannot be validly declared.
papers.coarse_rationale: 本文提出集体反事实规划的形式化模型，关注多智能体协调与验证，属于Agent推理方向，但更偏理论框架。
papers.newspaper_title: 集体规划的硬边界：无法表征的目标，不能被合法验证
papers.dek: CCP 把多智能体协作的失败归因于表征几何，而不仅是能力、知识或可观测性不足，给出了“偶然完成”与“可验证完成”之间的严格区分。
brief_points: 模型要求每个智能体只能通过自身子空间感知状态、构想动作、表达同意并验证目标；集体可解性因此同时受执行联盟、构想、同意和验证资格四道门限制。
迭代式跨智能体 relay 可能解锁任何单次计划池都没有的方案；相反，若目标要求依赖整个团队都无法表征的状态，即使轨迹偶然达成，也不能被有效验证为完成。
摘要称，在精确表示 relay closure 的条件下，四步穷举的有限时域方案是可靠且完备的；受限实现虽对返回方案保持可靠，却不保证完备。该结论不能直接外推到近似表示或开放时域部署。

papers.title: PlanPO: Group Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Agentic LLMs
papers.summary: Group-relative policy optimization has emerged as a key paradigm for training agentic large language models (LLMs) on multi-turn interactive tasks. However, most existing variants fail to distinguish advantages among successful trajectories even when these trajectories differ substantially in their interaction efficiency. For instance, circuitous successes are often assigned the identical outcome reward, causing advantage collapse and severe performance bottlenecks. To this end, we propose Group Planning-aware Policy Optimization (PlanPO), a simple yet effective RL method for learning generalizable planning abilities beyond task-specific high-quality behavior patterns. Specifically, PlanPO introduces coarse-to-fine advantage signals, which capture the relative differences in trajectory-level lengths and turn-level response lengths conditioned on successful trajectories sampled for the same task. Within the group-relative optimization structure, this enables agents to actively learn generalizable and deliberate behaviors spanning interaction planning and textual generation from high-quality rollouts, without degenerating into vanilla length minimization. Experimentally, PlanPO improves over GRPO by 27.2\% on average across the challenging multi-turn benchmarks ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld, outperforming recent powerful baselines while incurring negligible additional training cost.

papers.newspaper_title: 成功不应抹平路径差异：PlanPO 重估多轮交互效率
papers.dek: PlanPO 针对多轮 Agent 训练中的优势塌缩，尝试从同一任务的成功轨迹中区分更高效与更迂回的交互路径。
brief_points: 当成功轨迹共享同一结果奖励时，任务完成但交互冗长的路径可能与高效路径获得相同优势，训练信号因而无法表达规划质量差异。
方法加入由粗到细的优势信号，同时考虑成功轨迹的总体长度和每轮响应长度，目标是学习更具泛化性的交互规划，而非退化为单纯追求更短输出。
在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SciWorld 上，摘要报告相对 GRPO 平均提升 27.2%，额外训练成本可忽略。摘要未提供绝对分数、方差、长度与成功率的拆分，因此无法判断收益主要来自

papers.title: AdaLens: Interactive Storyline for Monitoring and Steering Long-Running Agentic Data Analysis
papers.summary: Large language models are pushing data science toward increasingly autonomous and agentic workflows, with recent systems already supporting multi-step and long-running analyses. As these workflows become more autonomous, conventional interfaces no longer provide adequate support for two critical requirements: observability for understanding an agent's evolving reasoning and evidence, and steerability for redirecting low-value directions or deepening promising ones during execution. Existing interactive approaches improve process visibility and open intervention points, but they remain largely designed for discrete, turn-by-turn exchanges rather than the parallel branches and evolving decision structures of long-running agentic analysis. We study this need as interactive oversight in long-running agentic data analysis and present AdaLens, an interactive system for monitoring and steering ongoing runs. AdaLens combines a storyline-based representation that unifies analytical plans, execution progress, intermediate findings, and data-column involvement with steering interactions grounded in these analytical elements for directional guidance and execution control. We evaluate AdaLens through two case studies and a user study, examining how it supports analysts in monitoring and steering long-running agentic data analysis.
papers.coarse_rationale: 该论文针对长时运行的智能体数据分析提出交互式监控与引导系统，属于智能体工作流的人机交互研究方向，与核心主题Agentic AI高度相关，但对其他底层技术主题无直接贡献。
papers.newspaper_title: 长时运行智能体的另一种失效：看不见过程，也无法及时纠偏
papers.dek: AdaLens 将监督对象从单轮问答扩展到并行分支和持续演化的分析过程，聚焦智能体失去方向后，人类是否还能定位并介入。
brief_points: 论文认为，长时智能体数据分析同时需要可观测性和可操控性；面向离散、逐轮对话的界面难以表达并行分支、分析计划、执行进度和中间证据的变化。
AdaLens 用 storyline 统一呈现分析计划、执行进度、中间发现和涉及的数据列，并围绕这些分析元素提供方向引导与执行控制。
评估包括两个案例研究和一项用户研究，但摘要没有给出参与者数量、对照界面、量化指标或错误恢复结果。因此目前更适合作为监督接口设计的研究证据，不能据此证明它普遍降低了长时运行风险。

papers.title: When Agents Act on Web3: An Attack-Surface Survey of MCP, Skills, and Tool Calling
papers.summary: AI agents increasingly act rather than merely read: across the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem, the share of deployed tools that modify external state has risen from 27% to 65% of tool use. When agents exercise this authority on public blockchains through MCP, skills, and tool calling, the consequences of an attack are governed by the blockchain execution layer rather than by conventional software assumptions. This survey argues that four properties of that layer (irreversibility, signing authority, continuous autonomy, and sequence-level composition) qualitatively change the threat model, turning the recoverable failures of generic agent security into a standing, irreversible loss. We organize the fragmented MCP-security literature into an attack-surface taxonomy, then contribute a Web3 risk-mapping matrix that ties each attack class to its amplified impact, the responsible amplifiers, a representative mitigation, and the residual gap. We synthesize defenses, including emerging blockchain-based mechanisms, and find them improving but insufficient: measured protections stop fewer than 30% of attacks, and model-level safety refuses fewer than 3%. We close by positioning the work against adjacent surveys and deriving a research agenda from the matrix's open cells.

papers.newspaper_title: 工具调用进入不可逆环境后，普通 Agent 安全假设失效
papers.dek: 这篇调查把 MCP、Skills 和 tool calling 放入 Web3 执行环境考察，强调签名权限、持续自主性、序列组合与不可逆执行会放大一般智能体错误的后果。
brief_points: 论文将工具能够修改外部状态视为风险变化的信号，并主张区块链执行层会把原本可恢复的智能体失败转化为可能持续且不可逆的损失。
作者整理攻击面分类和 Web3 风险映射矩阵，将风险类别、放大因素、代表性缓解手段与剩余缺口关联起来，并综合讨论包括区块链机制在内的防御方案。
摘要报告现有测量型保护措施阻止的攻击少于 30%，模型级安全拒绝少于 3%；但未说明测量样本、攻击定义和评估协议，数字不应外推到所有 MCP 或工具调用部署。本文适合用于威胁建模与权限审查，不提供具体

papers.dek: 候选集中唯一满足高被引历史锚点条件的条目，题名与摘要片段却指向分数布朗运动和分数噪声，不能作为 CoT 或 Agent 理论沿革的有效参照。
brief_points: 该条目标注为 SIAM Review、引用量 7744、well-known 和 historical_anchor 均为 true，且输入贡献标签为 Planning。
但题名明确是 Fractional Brownian Motions、Fractional Noises 及其应用；摘要字段主要呈现书目信息和参考文献片段，没有提供 Chain-of-Thought、
因此它只能作为候选数据质量与主题相关性检查的反例，不能支撑今日主题的历史背景，也不应因引用量高而挤占真正相关论文的分析篇幅。
